```text
# #3912: Patch: the dungeon fight lists its live modifiers in full, as every other table's rail does
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Some cards put a lasting effect on a player, such as “Extra turns owed: 1”, “Your next refresh gives 0 mana” or a delayed effect counting down. Every other table has a small chip in its side rail that opens the full list of these effects: online matches, practice, daily games, co-op, watching, replays and the tutorial. On a phone the chip is the only way to read them, because the badges beside the hero are cut short and a touch screen never shows their hover text. A dungeon fight has no such chip. Once this is built, it shows the same chip and list.

## Why

- `apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.tsx` (R169) shows every live modifier, in full, one tap from the table's controls. Its header explains why: on a phone the badges are shortened, and their full text is a `title`, which a touch screen never shows.
- It sits in the rail of `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, `routes/practice.tsx:1124`, `daily/DailyBoard.tsx:222`, `duos/DuosBoard.tsx`, `together/WatchRoute.tsx`, `replay/ReplayPlayer.tsx` and `tutorial/TutorialHud.tsx`. The daily board's comment reads: every live modifier in full, one tap away, as every other table's rail lists them.
- `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx:307-315` passes `matchStatus` with the enemy's name, `RunTimer` and `ThinkIndicator` only, and never imports `ModifierList`.
- A fight plays catalog cards, and the engine lists their modifiers in `SideView.modifiers` (`crates/engine/src/view_for.rs`, around 1340-1370: extra turns owed, a 0-mana refresh, delayed effects).

## Proposal

Add `ModifierList` to FightScreen's `matchStatus` (`view={snapshot.view}`), with the enemy's translated name as its `opponentLabel`, as practice passes “AI”. Then check that the rail still fits beside the artifact trays at the phone breakpoint.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx`, `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.test.tsx`
- The fight's CSS, only if the rail overflows on a phone
- SPEC §15 (dungeon runs); R169

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A FightScreen test: a view with one modifier in `you.modifiers` shows the `modifier-list` chip with `data-count=1`, and tapping it opens `modifier-list-panel` holding that label.
- [ ] A modifier on the enemy's side is listed under the enemy's name.
- [ ] With no modifier on either side, no chip renders.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and the touched test files pass.

## Size and risks

Small: a few lines plus two or three tests. The only risk is crowding the fight's rail on a phone, and the chip renders nothing while no modifier is live.
```
